metadata.desc: Long-term memory and self-learning enhancement for AstrBot: layered adaptive retrieval, memory lifecycle, the reality bridge (weekly / diary / essay entries), reflective self-learning, plus optional persona learning (style / group jargon / affinity), knowledge graph, auto review and MaiBot-style boost; every prompt is customizable and a runtime monitor is built in.
